### Planned Server Roster

| Node | Role | User / Service | Current state |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `foobar-id-01` | Identity + shared homes | LDAP, Samba, phpLDAPadmin | Planned |
| `foobar-crm-01` | CRM | SuiteCRM, MariaDB, PHP | App VM lane |
| `foobar-tickets-01` | Helpdesk board | Kanboard, SQLite, PHP | App VM lane |
| `foobar-helpdesk-win-01` | Windows helpdesk | joe.user | PXE install |
| `foobar-helpdesk-win-02` | Windows helpdesk | jill.user | PXE install |
| `foobar-dev-linux-01` | Linux developer workstation | bob.dev1 | Planned |
| `foobar-dev-linux-02` | Linux developer workstation | bob.dev2 | Planned |

The app VM lane reuses the prepared Trixie base and creates stable PVE targets for later SuiteCRM/Kanboard package installation.
